items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Sonny, yeah. Anything you'd need. Yeah, Sonny was a nice guy.

ctx.x: Sonny, yeah. Anything you'd need. Yeah, Sonny was a nice guy. My wife was furious at me because one night I had some tickets to a Duke Ellington concert and I brought my daughter in for dinner. And all of a sudden I had to stay later, so I said, 'Sonny, will you take my daughter to Carnegie Hall?' And my wife said, 'who's that man who brought Anne to Carnegie Hall?' I said, Sonny. She said, 'Sonny's a
thief?" I said, yeah. She said, "you sent your daughter to Carnegie Hall with a thief?" I said, he's a nice guy, you know. I don't know he's a thief; just people say he's a thief.
